# Mayank Bansal

> just an engineer trying to create things that matter

i've worked with early-stage teams, moving between frontend, backend, and deployments wherever the product needed me.

i'm currently working on a bunch of experiments to push the limits of myself and what i can do with models.

## Work

- [snip](https://snip.mayank.fyi): a simple editor for small potato stuff. free, no watermarks, works offline.
- [common](https://www.usecommon.app): a common space for you, your people and your agents.
- [shift-read](https://shft.page): a focused reader that translates any article while preserving its structure and formatting.
- [chess with llm](https://chess.mayank.fyi/): a chess arena for playing legal, timed matches against open-weight LLMs.
- [wavmo playground](https://docs.mayank.fyi): an agentic writing workspace that plans, drafts, reviews, and improves technical documents.
- [sketchicon](https://sketchicon.com): 1,700+ deterministic, customizable hand-drawn SVG icons for React.
- [Work history](https://www.mayank.fyi/work)
- [Writing](https://www.mayank.fyi/writing)
